scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,yellow "npm run dev -w @freshflow/backend" "npm run dev -w @freshflow/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @freshflow/shared && npm run prisma:generate -w @freshflow/backend && npm run build -w @freshflow/backend && npm run build -w @freshflow/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @freshflow/shared && npm run prisma:generate -w @freshflow/backend && tsc -p backend --noEmit && tsc -p frontend --noEmit
